run_mrqa_training: run BERT training on MRQA dataset with dev evaluation and checkpoint saving
evaluate_model: evaluate a trained BERT question-answering model on dev or test set and compute exact match and F1 scores
make_predictions: generate n-best answer predictions from BERT start and end logits for MRQA examples
read_mrqa_examples: read a gzipped MRQA JSON dataset file into a list of MRQAExample objects
convert_examples_to_features: convert MRQA examples into tokenized InputFeatures with sliding window document spans
